rationale: Mufaddal's deep expertise in embedded systems, connectivity, and OTA update architecture could be valuable technical input for TheAgentic.Ai's production infrastructure work, particularly as AI agents move into hardware-adjacent sectors like biotech and fintech. intro_message: Mufaddal, meet Sharon from TheAgentic.Ai—she's building production AI agent infrastructure and your experience shipping embedded systems at scale could inform how agentic systems handle real-world reliability demands.
